what: Confirmed all 4,369 first-applied spoof poses from three Unreal Live Link subjects matched in Luna2 Isaac Sim, including readback of the USD joint positions.
why: The robot simulation can use the same evaluated pose as the Unreal editor, with measured timing at the physics callback.
details: 1,454 physics ticks applied new poses for all three performers. Unreal evaluation to Isaac application was 107.6 ms median and 121.9 ms p95, including a configured 100 ms playout delay.
